Maya (CS): OrchidTech asking for a short onboarding change for a regional campaign: route into me-north-1, partner CIDR allowlist, SAML SSO, and temporary QPS bump for 10 days. They also asked for a KMS note for procurement/renewal.

Elliot (OrchidTech): Confirming window 2025-04-20 -> 2025-04-30, business hours 08:00-20:00 GST. Baseline QPS 220, target burst to 800 for /v1/generate. CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24 and 203.0.114.6/32. Egress ~260Mbps.

Sana (NetOps): Please confirm if client certs needed. We can request peering to me-north-1 and apply ephemeral allowlist with auto-revoke.

Elliot (OrchidTech): No client certs initially, tokens only. Auto-revoke required.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Plan: 1) create ephemeral allowlist entries auto-revoke 2025-05-01; 2) apply temporary QPS profile "orchid-promo-800" scoped to me-north-1 and routes /v1/generate; 3) schedule 30m SAML metadata exchange; 4) open Private deploy discovery ticket for KMS details.

Bea (AE): Renewal risk flagged  they want a region-residency log bundle and a KMS isolation statement to satisfy procurement. I'll own the renewal artifact and work with Security.

Maya (CS): I'll book SAML call tomorrow 09:30 GST and prepare a short runbook. Elliot, confirm if embeddings need a cap.

Elliot (OrchidTech): Embeddings low volume, keep at default.

provision-bot: Ticket CS-11099 created. Peering PoP reservation ETA ~18h. Promo profile applied to staging; auto-revoke timer scheduled.

Sana (NetOps): Provision checklist posted in CS-11099: open peering request me-north-1; apply allowlist 203.0.113.0/24 and 203.0.114.6/32 (auto-revoke 2025-05-01T00:00:00Z); apply policy orchid-promo-800 active 08:00-20:00 GST; monitoring alert at 75% -> notify @Maya.

Maya (CS): Recap: CS-11099 covers peering + ephemeral allowlist + promo profile + SAML call tomorrow 09:30 GST. Renewal doc owned by Bea. Ping here for changes.

Elliot (OrchidTech): Thanks team, please ensure allowlist auto-revokes and audit logs available.

(END)
